# documents

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/atlassian/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/atlassian/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

Atlassian-owned native document representation and membership vocabulary.

`connectors_atlassian.documents` is one of connectors_atlassian's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `CqlSearchSelection`

`connectors_atlassian.documents.CqlSearchSelection` is a record of three fields:

- `cql` — `String`
- `limit` — `Integer`
- `max_body_bytes` — `Integer`

Every value satisfies `(limit >= 1 and limit <= 100)`.

### `DocumentRepresentation`

`connectors_atlassian.documents.DocumentRepresentation` is one of `confluence_storage` and `jira_fields_v2`.

### `DocumentScopeKind`

`connectors_atlassian.documents.DocumentScopeKind` is one of `confluence_space` and `jira_project`.

Three of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_atlassian.documents.CqlSearchSelection`, `connectors_atlassian.documents.DocumentRepresentation` and `connectors_atlassian.documents.DocumentScopeKind`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
